english.terminal_text: And it is said: "Allah made him"

source_witnesses.locator: Al-Jami li-Ahkam al-Qur'an, Surah 108:3, displayed printed page 222; lexical passage begins at قال أهل اللغة and continues into the next displayed line
source_witnesses.evidence: The displayed Qurtubi text has the unattributed lexical citation وفي الحديث ما هذه البتيراء.
source_witnesses.relation: direct_work_witness; confirms phrase placement, not its underlying hadith chain

source_witnesses.locator: Ibn al-Athir, al-Nihaya fi Gharib al-Hadith wa-al-Athar, vol. 1, printed p. 94, root بتر
source_witnesses.evidence: The lexical entry first explains البتيراء and then cites the report of Sa'd praying one rak'ah, with Ibn Mas'ud objecting ما هذه البتيراء؟
source_witnesses.relation: later lexicographic contextual witness for the exact short wording
source_witnesses.limit: This parallel makes a possible context identifiable; it does not prove this was the specific source Qurtubi intended or supply Qurtubi's missing isnad.

source_witnesses.locator: Sunan Ibn Majah, Kitab Iqamat al-Salah, hadith 1176
source_witnesses.evidence: Al-Muttalib reports that a man asks Ibn Umar about one-rak'ah witr and fears people will call it al-batirā; Ibn Umar answers that it is the Sunnah of God and His Messenger.
source_witnesses.relation: distinct wording and dialogue from the Qurtubi/Ibn al-Athir short phrase; not to be substituted for it

source_witnesses.evidence: A route through al-Muttalib ibn Abd Allah al-Makhzumi and al-Awza'i records a man brought to Ibn Umar, who advises one rak'ah; the man fears the label al-batirā.
source_witnesses.relation: parallel to the Ibn Umar dialogue, not proof of Qurtubi's unnamed citation

source_boundary_findings.qurtubi_authorial_voice: The lexical paragraph states only 'and in the hadith'; no narrator, collection, or chain is present in the live row.
source_boundary_findings.exact_phrase_context_found_in_later_lexi: Ibn al-Athir locates the exact question wording in an anecdote about Sa'd praying one rak'ah and Ibn Mas'ud objecting.
source_boundary_findings.different_ibn_umar_wording: Ibn Majah 1176 and Bayhaqi 4568 contain a separate exchange about fear that people would use the label al-batirā; they do not give Qurtubi's exact question as the man's wording.

explicit_non_assimilation: Do not append Ibn al-Athir's Ibn Mas'ud/Sa'd context or chain to Qurtubi's text.
Do not conflate the Ibn Umar dialogue in Ibn Majah 1176 or al-Bayhaqi 4568 with Ibn al-Athir's separate Ibn Mas'ud/Sa'd anecdote.
Do not present the lexical citation as a verified Prophetic hadith or claim a source chain absent from Qurtubi.
The Qurtubi English row remains cut off mid-sentence at 'Allah made him'; this review does not repair or complete it.
